Name: HxW Custom Buildings All in One Pack
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/nfUW6xU.png[/img][/size][/font]

This mod contains every released HxW Custom Building mod all packaged into one! It's highly customizable and you can choose which buildings you want to enable using Generic Mod Config Menu! This pack is meant for those who want to get ALL our buildings as soon as they're uploaded and don't want to bother with downloading individual ones. New buildings will be added to this as well!

[b][size=6][quote]IMPORTANT UPDATE INFORMATION FOR VERSION 2.0[/quote][/size][/b]
[font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia][size=3]The code had to be overhauled for our buildings because to be honest, we ended up with so many that it was getting quite messy in there and hard to find bugs and things. Because of this, the internal IDs of nearly all of the buildings have changed and therefore the game will [i]not[/i] recognize your buildings from the previous version of the mod.  For a[b] new save[/b], or a save where you have not built any of our buildings yet, this is fine and you can just install and enjoy! [b]
[/b][/size][/font]
[/size][color=#f6b26b][size=3][b]YOU MUST FOLLOW THESE DIRECTIONS BEFORE UPDATING THE BUILDINGS MOD IF YOU HAVE AN EXISTING SAVE[/b][/size][/color][/font][color=#f6b26b]:[/color][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia][size=3][list=1]
[*]Load your existing save and empty out any existing HXW Buildings you have of all contents. Store it all wherever you want just NOT IN THE BUILDING.
[*]Visit Robin and demolish these buildings. Sorry but they have to be gone before you update the mod.
[*]Save the game and exit. 
[*]Delete the old version of the mod and cleanly install the new version. 
[*]If you wish to give yourself enough $ to re-purchase the buildings you had to demolish, use a mod like CJB Cheats that will allow you to do so.
[*]Run the game and check the configurations in Generic Mod Config Menu to make sure it looks correct.
[*]Give yourself the money you need and visit Robin and rebuild the buildings you had to demolish.
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][color=#f6b26b][size=3][i]
We know this is a bit of a headache now but trust us, this was a band-aid that had to come off so we appreciate your understanding![/i][/size][/color][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font][center][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5][b][u]Current Buildings Available:
[/u][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

[/size][size=4][b]Brewery [/b]
[/size][size=3]
[font=Georgia]Adds a seasonal brewery building to age casks in, with two large upgrades for maximum production efficiency. Process your kegs 15% faster inside of the building! 
[/font][/size]
[size=4][b]Winery[/b][/size][size=3]

﻿﻿Adds a seasonal winery building to age casks in. Process your kegs 15% faster inside of the building! Furnished option comes with [b]FREE [/b]placeable furniture & a [b]FREE[/b] winery furniture catalogue. 

[/size][size=4][b]Tea Shop[/b][/size][size=3]

﻿﻿Adds a seasonal, upgradable tea shop upgrade for your Shed! Featuring Yri's foliage. Location bonus: 15% speed increase to WAG's Tea Processor and Tea Kettle inside the tea shop!

[/size][size=4][b]Bakery[/b][/size][size=3]

﻿﻿Adds a seasonal, upgradable bakery upgrade for your Shed! Featuring Yri's foliage.[b] Note: [/b]If using [b]PIF [/b]rooms, please pair it with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise furniture[/url]﻿ in order to bring the door down to level.

[/size][size=4][b]Tea Conservatory[/b][/size]

[font=Georgia][b] [/b][size=3]A gorgeous building themed around Caroline's sunroom, with plenty of space inside to grow crops and tea saplings.
[/size][size=4]
[b]Flower Shop/Florist[/b][/size]

A florist-themed building with 2 optional upgrades to increase the interior size. It includes a front shop-room/open space and a "back greenhouse" space for planting seeds and saplings.[b]

[/b][/font][font=Georgia][size=5][b](with Several More Planned!)[/b][/size][/font][size=3]

[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5][b]BONUS: [/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]new option to change the interior of your slime hutch to one of our custom building interiors! Say no to slime husbandry and instead turn that slime hutch into a bakery, winery or tea shop.


[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=6][b][/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/vsca1L9.png[/img][/size][/font][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

[font=Georgia][size=3]-The "Shed" version of any of these buildings is specifically available for those who want to use this with Market Town. It is NOT compatible with other custom shed mods. If you want to be able to use other custom shed maps, you must use the "Building" version. 
[/size][/font]
-If you are using any of the existing solo versions of these buildings, please note that those buildings would need to be demolished/removed prior to installing this.

If you wish to disable a building type, be sure to [b]DEMOLISH[/b] any existing versions of that building on your farm before doing so.
- The slime hutch renovation is not compatible with any other mod that changes the interior of the slime hutch. It is disabled by default though, so you don't HAVE to use it if you don't want to.

-The slime hutch water troughs are removed but that one incubator still shows up in the top left - you can use a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]NoClip[/url]﻿ and then your pickaxe to pick it up and remove it.

- For the "furnished" option to work, you[b] MUST[/b] have the appropriate furniture set installed, otherwise the mod won't know what to spawn in. The furniture that is placed inside is movable just like any other furniture! If you don't mind the building being empty, then you don't need to have the furniture installed.
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
For Winery Building to come furnished - you must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32162]Winery Furniture[/url]﻿ installed.
For Tea Shop Building [font=Georgia][size=3]to come furnished[/size][/font] - you must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27124]Plant Lovers Furniture[/url]﻿ installed.
For Bakery Building [font=Georgia][size=3]to come furnished[/size][/font] - you must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9991]Bakery Cafe Furniture[/url]﻿ installed.
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][size=6][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/nY2cWBM.png[/img][/size][/font]
